combats.encounter: Scryed simulacrum fight with pirate Wellby
combats.note: The party watches remotely. The fight is already underway when scrying opens; round 1 is the first recorded cycle. Source narration combines the pirates and Wellby in the second volley.

entries.summary: Six human pirates surround the Kenzo simulacrum and swing scimitars.
Fires an arrow from about twenty feet away; the simulacrum bats it away.
Deflects the incoming arrow.
Swarm the simulacrum and land blows despite its dodging, leaving it limping.
Draws energy into itself, dodges through the pirates and rushes Wellby. Its first blow misses and second hits, staggering Wellby.
Retreats into the pirate crowd after the second punch; holds a nocked arrow and orders a charge.
entries.note: Narrated off-turn retreat; no named reaction ability is supplied.

entries.summary: Pirates charge but cannot hit the dodging simulacrum. Wellby lands a clean arrow strike that the simulacrum partly deflects, leaving only a scrape.
Partly deflects Wellby’s second arrow.

Uses a glowing blue planar fist to knock Wellby over the bow into the sea after a failed Strength save. Leaps onto the water, runs after him, drinks the transformation potion and dives to force the drowning doppelganger down.
While choking and drowning, punches the simulacrum, then vanishes in a flash.

ending.summary: The Wellby doppelganger vanishes; the simulacrum survives beneath the pirate ship. No permanent death is established.

combats.encounter: Damaged colossus in the Shaking Tooth
combats.note: The encounter uses repeated declared turns and readied attacks without an initiative roll. Each later cycle includes a ten-minute Radiance hold, not a six-second round. There is no resolved Banishment, imprisonment or mirror capture.

openingActions.summary: Fires a light beam at Wellby. His Dexterity save fails; Evasion reduces the initially stated 60 radiant damage to 30.
Retreats upstairs to the party, smoking, and recommends leaving.
Uses Clairvoyance to examine the level beneath the colossus, finding a sand-filled room and buried stairs.

entries.summary: Casts Sanctuary, takes cover at the stairs (+5 to Dexterity saves), then exposes himself to cast Sickening Radiance. After the colossus’s readied beam he successfully casts and retreats. Radiance deals 4d10 radiant damage per failed DC 19 Constitution save; the table corrects the full ten-minute duration to 100 saves. The colossus takes damage but remains standing and is immune to exhaustion.

Succeeds on the Sanctuary save with 27 and fires its readied eye beam. Delwath fails the Dexterity save even after cover and Inspiration bring it to 17; he takes 55 radiant damage before his Radiance goes off.
Provides Inspiration during Delwath’s save and heals him twice afterward: 15 and 16 hit points.
Repeats Sanctuary and Sickening Radiance, then crawls backward to cover after being knocked prone. Misty Step is considered and withdrawn. The second Radiance runs for ten minutes.
Succeeds on Sanctuary again. The DM replaces the proposed eye beam with a force attack roll that hits Delwath for 14 damage and knocks him prone.
Propped on its legless torso, pounds harder and spends the ten-minute Radiance interval trying to smash the bottom of the stairs. Its movement slows but it does not fall.

Uses Armor of Agathys, Sanctuary (DC 18), and a third Sickening Radiance, following the same exposure and retreat. The accepted retained Dexterity roll of 20 succeeds with +5 cover against the beam. He reports only 5 damage reaching him after Armor of Agathys absorbs part of the 30 damage.
entries.note: The earlier proposed ten-point absorption and later reported five damage do not reconcile arithmetically. Preserve both the DM’s 30 damage and the player’s reported remaining damage without inventing an HP ledger.

entries.summary: Uses its eye beam again; Delwath succeeds on the Dexterity save with cover and the DM assigns 30 damage.
Falls with a thud about six minutes into the third Radiance.
Keeps the third Radiance up until the full ten minutes expire before investigation.
Flies down and reveals the colossus keeled over, with nothing moving. The DM explicitly confirms it is dead.

ending.summary: The colossus is confirmed dead after three Radiance intervals. The party is free to investigate the buried floors.

combats.encounter: Seeker encounters the basement stone golem

entries.summary: Acts first (initiative 11 against 2) and casts Wall of Stone to box in the golem. It succeeds on the DC 18 Dexterity save and runs out before enclosure.

Uses its slowing gaze. Seeker fails a Wisdom save with 10: no reactions, half speed, at most one attack, and either an action or bonus action. Spellcasting remains possible; a repeat save is allowed at the end of each turn.
Dimension Doors vertically back up to the other PCs, preserving his seventh-level Teleport slot.

ending.summary: Seeker escapes; the stone golem remains alive in the storeroom for a later return.

combats.encounter: Party returns to the basement stone golem

entries.summary: Rushes forward and lands four blows for 7, 10, 12 and 13 damage. The golem fails a Charisma save but is immune to charm, so the proposed charm is replaced by Stunning Strike; it succeeds on the Constitution save with 25. The golem is also stated immune to exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, poison damage and psychic damage.
Steps forward and projects its slowing aura. All four PCs succeed on their Wisdom saves (Kenzo 23, Delwath 21, Wellby 17 and Seeker 20); nobody is slowed.
Uses Steady Aim and shoots with Cunning Strike trip: a 16 misses and the 28 hits. Damage is initially stated as 28 then corrected to 27. The golem fails the DC 18 Dexterity save and falls prone.
entries.note: The two attack results are narrated with Steady Aim as one shot, not two separately resolved arrows.

entries.summary: Casts Catapult with a rock; the golem fails its DC 18 Dexterity save and takes 24 bludgeoning damage.

Steps into melee against the prone golem, with close-range advantage established, and makes three attacks for 9, 14 and 19 damage. Banishing Smite adds 28 damage, but the tower’s planar ward prevents the banishment.
Hits with 17 for 13 damage and declares another Stunning Strike; the punch kills the golem before any additional save is resolved.

ending.summary: The stone golem falls backward and cracks in half; combat ends before the party examines the chests and scrolls.
